_comment: Golden prompts for scripts/eval.py. expected_tools is a SUBSEQUENCE match against the tool calls streamed by the agent (extra tools in between are fine); forbidden_text must not appear anywhere in the stream. Calibrated against the dev runtime 2026-09-17 (task 9.4) and re-calibrated 2026-09-18 for eyes (inspect_image after every imagery fetch). ArcGIS MCP tools (find_address_candidates, reverse_geocode) are deliberately NOT expected: the agent drops them gracefully when the MCP is unreachable and the gate must not fail on a third-party outage.
